profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Bill.com
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the entertainment, storage, fintech, and tax industries using various technologies. Strong engineer professional with a Computer Engineering degree from Brigham Young University.

positions.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Technical Lead
positions.description:
Development and maintenance of a complex microservice architecture.
Implement feature requests ranging from authentication to email services.
Set, maintain, and educate on standards set for an engineering group.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develop and maintain a complex microservices architecture for cloud based accounting CRM software. Provide services related but not limited to user accounts, security, email connections, calendars, in-app and mobile notifications, and CRM contact management.
Plan out, engineer, and deploy new feature sets across various microservices in coordination with marketing, QA, support, and PM teams.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Maintain and develop Python code for backend content delivery and management systems.
Anticipate technological and standards changes for content encryption, encoding, and delivery.
Communicate and coordinate bug fixes and feature enhancements with various development and operations teams.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer in Test
positions.description:
QA Team lead.
Created automation framework to test content delivery systems.
Managed and programmed tests in a complex environment.
Coordinated information between dev teams and QA teams.

positions.title: Software QA Engineer
positions.description: Working on the Management QA team to prototype, create, and maintain automation code suites. Providing support for SMI-s, IBM Director, and Systems Center Operations Manager automation and testing.

positions.title: Intern - QA
positions.description: Working on the System Level Test Team to validate Fusion-IO products, address customer-facing issues, and develop tests. This required knowledge of python to develop numerous types of tests to be run against a wide variety of system configurations. Continued support and feature enhancements to existing and upcoming tests and test-cases were also part of my responsibility. Knowledge of the Linux OS and how the card behaves in conjunction with utilities, firmware, and driver were necessary. Work as a team and with other teams was necessary to enhance understanding and tests to be developed and run.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Temporary intern in the legal department at HP-Korea.  Organized and filed legal papers for future reference.

positions.title: Missionary
positions.description: Administrative and technical office support for local mission office, local proselyting, coordination and execution of bike repairs and apartment relocations. I also searched, coordinated, and setup housing for missionaries in the area.

company.name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints

positions.title: Intern - EE department
positions.description: Translation of technical documents into English for publishing on the local department website.
